epics.title: Accountable engineering loop
epics.objective: Enforce decision 0032 end to end: JIT frontier contracts gated at stage start, evidence-backed grills, bounded reviewable diffs.

tasks.title: Task grills carry proof and rounds
tasks.objective: Task-gate grills require inspected_refs (existing working-tree paths), current_flow, a total criteria_map, a keep/split/block decision, declare-or-empty new_abstractions, and per-finding accountability: every gap is covered by a rounds entry ({question, options, chosen} - the operator's AskUserQuestion pick) or a citation (document-dictated answer with named source); pass with split/block refused; block requires an escalation packet. Existing task-grill fixtures migrate.
acceptance_criteria: a task grill missing any proof field, with an unmapped criterion, a gap covered by neither a rounds entry nor a citation, pass+split/block, or block without an escalation packet is refused
rounds entries carry {question, options, chosen}; citations name their source document
a fully-proved grill records; existing suite green after fixture migration

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: Task-gate-only conditionality is the risky seam: spec/signoff/epics/plan grill payloads must keep recording unchanged - regression risk across every existing gate fixture. inspected_refs existence-checking accepts path and path:symbol refs (validate the path part; a missing path refuses). Criteria coverage compares against the frontier task's acceptance_criteria in the PROTECTED decomposition, never the caller payload. Per-finding accountability is deterministic: every gap maps to a rounds entry ({question, options, chosen} - shape-checked) or a citation with a named source; the recorder refuses uncovered gaps - this encodes the operator's per-finding-choice protocol, not blanket sanction. New fields are machine evidence: keep values free of secret-shaped strings (evidence-vs-tooling watch class).

plan_contracts.statement: a task grill missing inspected_refs/current_flow/criteria_map/decision/new_abstractions, with an unmapped criterion, a gap covered by neither a {question, options, chosen} rounds entry nor a source-named citation, or pass+split/block is refused
block without escalation_packet {issue, evidence, recommendation, alternatives, rollback} is refused
existing task-grill fixtures migrate via the shared helper and the suite stays green

tasks.title: Grounding digest derived internally
tasks.objective: record_grill_from_json.py derives the task-grill digest from the full contract, the approved-plan digest excluding appended assumptions, and a product-tree hash excluding .factory/ and plans/; --task-digest is removed; require_task_grill and task_frontier_state re-derive.
acceptance_criteria: contract, plan-body, and product-tree changes each stale a grill; .factory/ and plans/ commits and forge plan assume do not
caller-supplied --task-digest is gone; gates and recorder agree on the derivation

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: The staleness matrix is the contract: contract-field change, plan-body change (excluding the appended Implementation Assumptions section - recorded lesson), and any product commit each stale a grill; commits touching only .factory/ or plans/ do NOT, or the regrill treadmill returns. product_tree_digest hashes the index blob list (path+sha) excluding those prefixes - deterministic, no mtime. Stage measurement's task_sha256 (four-field) is UNCHANGED - grounding_digest is the grill binding only; do not couple the two (decision 0023 no-rebaseline). --task-digest removal breaks callers: the refusal message tells them the digest is now derived. Self-application: the very next grill (ACC2-T3's) records under this derivation.

plan_contracts.statement: contract, plan-body, and product-tree changes each stale a grill; .factory/ and plans/ commits and forge plan assume do not
caller-supplied --task-digest is gone; recorder and gates derive the same grounding digest

tasks.title: Frozen skeleton, immutable completed contracts, plan_contracts wiring
tasks.objective: Initial decomposition recording refuses execution detail on every task and reviewer_focus/plan_contracts on non-frontier tasks; re-records freeze pending id/order/dependencies and refuse changes to a done task's full contract; the task grill refuses when criteria_map does not cover acceptance criteria or mismatches declared plan_contracts.
acceptance_criteria: first recording is fully skeletal; pending graph edits refused; done contracts immutable under a full-contract digest
criteria_map must cover acceptance criteria and match plan_contracts or the grill is refused

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: Three seams. (1) First-recording detection is 'no protected authority exists'; the legacy-migration fixture flow becomes record-skeletal -> re-record frontier detail -> drop authority; prepare_legacy_stage_migration and stage-migrate tests must survive (recorded lesson: migrate before re-recording). (2) The freeze must not break the sanctioned mid-stage scope repair: re-recording the ACTIVE frontier task's contract fields stays legal; only pending id/order/dependency edits and done-task contract changes refuse. (3) plan_contracts binding is deterministic: the set of plan_contract statements equals the set of criteria_map keys (= protected acceptance criteria); the grill recorder refuses a mismatch; review-side verdicts are already FORGE-REV-2's.

plan_contracts.statement: the task grill refuses when criteria_map does not cover the protected acceptance criteria or plan_contracts statements mismatch it
first recording is fully skeletal; pending graph edits refuse; done contracts are immutable under a full-contract digest

tasks.title: Review budget at stage done and in the brief
tasks.objective: Tasks may declare review_budget (default 8 files/400 lines excluding .factory/ and plans/; lower free, higher needs a written reason); stage done refuses an over-budget diff with split guidance; the composed brief states the budget and the conduct s8 narration line.
acceptance_criteria: default, lowered, justified-higher, and exceeded budgets behave as specified at stage done
the brief carries the budget and narration lines

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: Counting is the risky seam: files and lines (additions+deletions) measured over the SAME diff _measure already computes (baseline to now, commits plus working tree), excluding .factory/ and plans/ exactly as measurement's evidence exclusions do - two different diff computations would let the budget and the measurement disagree. Default 8 files/400 lines is a policy target (recorded p90s 5/256 product-only, 20/672 all-paths) - state it in the refusal. Raising needs a non-empty written reason validated at record time; lowering is free. The over-budget refusal names the split path (grill decision=split, prefix-freeze appends from T3). Brief additions are two lines in compose_brief - budget and the conduct s8 narration line - no new sections. Lite/quickfix/degraded windows untouched.

plan_contracts.statement: default, lowered, justified-higher, and exceeded budgets behave as specified at stage done
the brief carries the budget and narration lines

tasks.title: Board renders task rows
tasks.objective: The board's in-flight story drawer shows one row per task (state skeleton|ready|grilled|active|done, grill freshness, budget usage) from the same shared derivation forge next uses.
acceptance_criteria: board task rows match task_frontier_state for every state

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: One derivation, two consumers: extend factory_lib with task_rows(root) returning ALL tasks' states (skeleton|ready|grilled|active|done, grill fresh/stale via the same grounding_digest compare, budget used/limit for the active stage via the same _measure-consistent counting), built ON TOP of the pieces task_frontier_state uses so routing and board can never disagree; task_frontier_state stays the single-action authority. Board renders rows in the story drawer read-only - no new endpoints, no approval affordances (the board never approves). Budget usage calls the same counting helper stages.py uses - do not reimplement the diff walk. Board redundancy watch-class: keep row derivation one call per render.

plan_contracts.statement: board task rows match task_frontier_state for every state
